key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20C4
name: set_bit0_over_index_range
description: Sets the lowest bit of every byte in a buffer, walking the index downward from a starting offset to zero. The loop is the whole routine and it returns after the index passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20D0
name: or_control_mask_until_flag
description: Picks a bit mask from a control byte (4 for a value of 1, 8 for a value of 2, otherwise 0) and ORs it into a buffer walking backwards from a start index. The walk stops early when the matching byte in a second buffer has its top bit set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:210A
name: set_tile_mask_and_marker
description: When the control byte is neither 1 nor 2, ORs a mask of 48 or 176 into one buffer cell, chosen by whether a neighbouring type byte equals 8. If a configuration word is nonzero, it scans left for a cell flagged in a second buffer and rewrites that cell's low nibble to 4.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2160
name: add_word_to_table_entries
description: Reads a word from a structure, and when a field is zero runs a fixed sequence of helper calls (four extra when a second flag is set). It then adds the word to eight consecutive long entries of a table held in the structure.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21B8
name: compute_and_store_clamped_level
description: Computes a level from a per-step index and a divided counter, clamps it into the range 125 to 165, and stores it as a byte in a table at the position given by the caller's index.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21F2
name: clamp_value_and_store_char
description: Clamps an input word into the range 125 to 165 and stores the low byte at a base pointer plus an index. Values below 126 become 125 and values above 164 become 165.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:220C
name: adjust_flagged_entries_by_gaps
description: Computes a divided step from a word and a per-entry offset, then adds it to a range of table bytes. It walks backwards adding scaled absolute differences between neighbouring entries whose flag bit is set, and a final pass adjusts flagged entries using bits from a type byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:22B6
name: adjust_table_values_loop
description: Repeatedly adds a scaled absolute difference between two table entries to a destination byte, scanning backwards with flag bits to find matching entries. When the scan finishes it applies a scaled adjustment to every flagged entry in the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:230C
name: compute_scaled_output_tables
description: For each flagged index walking downward, derives two signed scaled values from a type nibble and the entry, and writes them to two output tables with a clamp at zero on one. Where a bit is set and the nibble is zero it adds a further signed correction to both outputs, then copies one byte to a third table with an offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2394
name: scale_flagged_entries_backwards
description: Repeatedly scales flagged entries from a start index downward by a signed multiplier and a type nibble, writing results into two output tables. When the index runs out it copies one byte to an output position with an offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23B2
name: compute_scaled_char_values
description: Loops over a range of indices, using flag bits to select entries and computing scaled character values from two tables with multiplications and shifts. It writes the results to two destination tables, updates a running accumulator, and at the end of the range copies a byte and modifies it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23CE
name: smooth_adjacent_flagged_entries
description: Walks flagged entries backwards, scaling and adjusting pairs of neighbouring values according to the distance between them. A second pass writes output bytes from a running maximum for entries with one type bit set and from a constant offset for entries with another.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23E0
name: smooth_flagged_pair_range
description: Scales and adjusts pairs of flagged neighbouring entries over a descending index range, choosing multipliers from the pair distance. A final pass writes output bytes from a running maximum or a constant offset depending on type bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:240C
name: scale_flagged_pairs_with_outputs
description: Adjusts neighbouring table entries in pairs with scaled residuals, writing the results into two output tables. Once the index reaches the start it runs a final pass that sets output bytes from a running maximum or a constant offset by type bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:242A
name: scale_adjacent_pairs_ordered_outputs
description: Updates neighbouring entry pairs by scaled residuals and writes the derived values into two tables. A final ordered pass sets output bytes from a running maximum for one type and a constant offset for another.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:244A
name: apply_pair_scaling_with_outputs
description: Applies scaled residual updates to neighbouring pairs in a table and stores them to output tables. A closing pass computes flagged output bytes from a running maximum or a constant offset depending on type bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:246A
name: update_pair_residuals_and_maxima
description: Adjusts a pair of neighbouring table entries by a scaled residual, then in a final pass writes output bytes for flagged entries. It uses a running maximum of earlier entries for one type bit and a constant offset for another.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:248E
name: offset_entry_scale_flagged_pairs
description: Adds a constant from a register to one table entry, then performs the same flagged pair scaling and final output pass as the neighbouring routines. Only the first instructions are visible in this excerpt beyond that.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2496
name: scale_pair_by_control_step
description: Scales a neighbouring pair of entries by a multiplier chosen from a control value (19, 32 or 38 for the first entry, 13 or 19 for the second), then updates output bytes and runs the flagged output pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24BE
name: scale_pair_by_stack_multiplier
description: Scales a neighbouring pair of table entries by a multiplier taken from a stack argument, then updates output bytes and runs the flagged output pass. It uses the same offset comparison as the other pair routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24DA
name: scale_pair_by_signed_step
description: Scales a neighbouring pair of table entries by a signed multiplier chosen from a stack control value, then runs the flagged output pass that sets output bytes from a running maximum or a constant offset depending on type bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2506
name: scale_second_entry_output_pass
description: Scales the second entry of a neighbouring pair by a control-dependent multiplier, adjusts a flagged entry, and then runs the flagged output pass with running maximum and constant offset writes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2532
name: scale_pairs_negative_residual
description: Adjusts neighbouring pairs of table entries with negated scaled residuals and writes results to an output table. It is called from several places and ends with the same flagged output pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25AC
name: write_running_maximum_and_offsets
description: Computes a running maximum over the table bytes below an index and writes a scaled maximum to an output table. It then walks backwards writing constant offsets for flagged entries with particular type bits, stopping at the start of the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25C0
name: update_running_maxima_with_residuals
description: Computes a running maximum over earlier table bytes and writes a scaled result to an output table. It then walks backwards writing constant offsets for flagged entries and feeds a scaled residual into the next step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25D4
name: scale_residuals_from_running_maximum
description: Tracks a running maximum over a byte range and writes scaled results from it into an output table. Flagged entries receive a constant offset or a scaled residual from the value found at each step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25F8
name: scale_flagged_bytes_by_sign
description: Walks an index downward over a range and, for each byte whose high nibble is nonzero, multiplies a second table entry by 38 or by minus 102 depending on the top bit of the flag byte. The scaled value is added back to the entry with rounding.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2608
name: scale_table_bytes_by_nibble
description: For each index in a range whose flag byte has a nonzero high nibble, scales the table byte by 38 or minus 102 chosen from the flag's top bit. The result is added back with rounding, and the routine returns when the index passes zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2632
name: scale_buffer_by_signed_factor
description: Walks a byte range backwards, skipping bytes whose high nibble is zero, and adds a shifted accumulator to a destination byte. A signed factor chosen from a source byte bit multiplies the destination byte to update the accumulator, and the loop repeats.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2642
name: distribute_pair_residuals_across_range
description: Initialises per-entry differences from three tables, then walks pairs of flagged indices and splits each residual between neighbours in halves. Entries between flagged points receive a fixed offset of 5 when a nibble flag is set, and short ranges are handled by helper calls.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:26E8
name: copy_range_and_offset_entries
description: Copies bytes between two tables across a range while subtracting a shared step, and stores each result offset by 5 in a third table. Afterwards it processes flagged pairs by halving residuals between neighbours.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:270C
name: fill_runs_from_control_index
description: Walks a range of flagged entries from a control index, copying values between tables and doubling a low nibble into an output table. Short runs are handled by helper calls, and each run ends with the same residual split.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:273A
name: copy_bytes_double_nibble_runs
description: Copies bytes between two tables for each position in a run, storing a value offset by 5 and computed from a low nibble doubled. The routine then splits residuals across the run, using helper calls for runs of one or two entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2762
name: split_residuals_over_flagged_runs
description: Splits a residual between neighbouring flagged entries and fills the entries in the run with values offset by 5 when a nibble flag is set. Runs of one or two entries are handled by helper calls and longer runs by a loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2770
name: split_residuals_and_fill_runs
description: Splits residuals between neighbouring flagged entries and fills runs with values offset by 5 when a nibble flag is set. Runs of length one and two use helper calls, and other lengths use a loop with a computed step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:277E
name: fill_run_with_stepped_values
description: Sets three tables to the constant 110 across a range and adds a doubled nibble to one table. For a flagged run it divides a table difference by the run length, writes stepped values offset by 5, and for one type writes a scaled running maximum into the end of the run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:278A
name: fill_tables_split_run_residuals
description: Fills three tables with the constant 110 plus a doubled nibble across a range, then finds the start of a flagged run and splits its residual evenly over the run. For one type it writes a scaled running maximum into the run's end, and for other types it writes constants 75 or 110.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27C8
name: split_run_residual_set_end
description: Finds the start of a flagged run walking backwards, divides its residual across the run, and fills the entries with values offset by 5. The end entry becomes a scaled running maximum for one type, or the constant 75 or 110 for the others.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27F2
name: step_copy_run_set_end
description: Copies a run of bytes between two tables while subtracting a fixed step, storing each result offset by 5 in a third table. It then sets the run's end entry from a scaled running maximum for one type, or to the constant 75 or 110 for the others.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:282C
name: write_end_value_from_maximum
description: Computes a running maximum over the table bytes below a range end and writes a scaled value there, offset by 5 in a second table. It also clears one flag entry and copies the preceding byte to a third table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2834
name: accumulate_bytes_and_write_results
description: Accumulates a running maximum over a range of bytes, derives a scaled value from it, and writes that value and a derived offset into several buffers. A second buffer receives a copy of a neighbouring byte when the range is longer than one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2864
name: apply_flag_scaled_offsets_backwards
description: Walks flagged entries backwards and, where a flag bit in a lookup word is set, applies scaled offsets to three tables using a multiplier of 26 or 102. For other entries it searches for the next flagged position and writes a constant chosen by a control value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:287E
name: apply_flag_offsets_run_search
description: Walks backwards over flagged entries using a lookup word from another buffer, applying scaled offsets to three tables. When a run is not flagged it searches for the next flag and writes a constant from a control value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28B8
name: scale_entry_then_search_flags
description: Applies a scaled offset to one table entry and writes a derived value to two tables. It then loops over the remaining entries, searching for the next flag and writing a constant when none is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28D2
name: scale_pair_flag_search_loop
description: Applies scaled offsets to a pair of table entries and then loops over the remaining positions. For each position it searches for the next flag, scales an entry by a multiplier, and writes the result to an output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2906
name: subtract_residual_with_flag_search
description: Adds a rounded scaled residual to one table and subtracts it from another across a range. It then searches for flagged entries, writing scaled values to output tables when a lookup word marks them.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:295C
name: apply_run_scale_flag_walk
description: Scales a run of entries from a constant starting value and writes the result to two tables. It then walks back over flagged entries, applying scaled offsets to three tables depending on a lookup word.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:296A
name: scale_run_by_constant_86
description: Scales a run of table entries by the constant 86 and writes the result to a second table. It then walks backwards over flagged entries, applying scaled offsets to three tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2970
name: scale_run_by_constant_26
description: Scales a run of table entries by the constant 26 and writes the result to a second table. It then walks backwards over flagged entries, applying scaled offsets to three tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:298E
name: adjust_flagged_attribute_buffers
description: Walks a byte array backwards and updates several attribute buffers, applying signed scaling and sign-bit adjustments. A lookup word decides whether a signed delta is applied to the attribute bytes in each buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A2
name: copy_bytes_with_feedback_loop
description: Copies bytes between two buffers while updating a feedback value from a table entry shifted right by seven. Each copied byte is reduced by the feedback and written to a third output area, looping over a count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A4
name: copy_adjust_bytes_with_feedback
description: Copies bytes between buffers, updating a feedback value by multiplying it with a table entry and shifting it. The feedback is subtracted from each byte and the adjusted bytes are written to two output areas.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29D4
name: check_narrator_flag_and_dispatch
description: Calls a fixed sequence of twelve helper routines, then calls one more when a flag byte in the data area is nonzero. It returns no value and writes no memory directly.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A4A
name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls a shared helper routine three times in sequence and returns. It has no other logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A6A
name: interpolate_and_store_bytes
description: Interpolates linearly between two bytes read from a buffer across a number of steps, and stores each interpolated byte at intervals of eight bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A92
name: skip_marked_records_until_end
description: Walks a buffer in records of eight bytes, skipping entries equal to minus 2 and calling a helper for records that are not on an eight-byte boundary. It returns when it reads minus 1.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AA4
name: advance_records_while_flagged
description: Steps through eight-byte records, calling a helper to move past the current record when it is not on an eight-byte boundary. It stops when a record's value is minus 1.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AB6
name: scan_records_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper routine, then scans eight-byte records until it finds a terminating minus 1 entry. Records on an eight-byte boundary are stepped over directly and others trigger the helper again.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ABA
name: scan_zero_records_minus_one
description: Scans eight-byte records until one with a nonzero entry is found, then stops at a minus 1 terminator or steps over the record. Records that are not on an eight-byte boundary call a helper first.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AD0
name: advance_records_until_sentinel
description: Advances a pointer through eight-byte records, calling a helper when the record is not on an eight-byte boundary. It stops once the record at the current position is a minus 1 sentinel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ADC
name: scan_records_past_zero_run
description: Calls a helper, then scans eight-byte records for the first nonzero entry, stepping past records that are all zero. It returns when the scan reaches a minus 1 terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AE0
name: write_table_patterns_per_code
description: Walks paired byte streams and, for each code with a flag bit set, writes five-row patterns from a global table into the output. Other codes either skip an output stride or copy a split nibble into the next record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B10
name: write_patterns_for_code_stream
description: Walks two byte streams and writes five-row patterns for flagged codes into the output buffer. Unflagged codes advance the output by a stride, and a paired flag selects a half-value copy.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B6A
name: emit_patterns_until_terminator
description: Loops over a code stream until a minus 1 terminator, writing five-row patterns for flagged codes and advancing the output by a stride for others. Paired flags select a halved count with extra adjustment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B70
name: emit_code_patterns_then_scan
description: Writes five-row patterns for a fixed code count, then scans the remaining code stream, advancing or writing output depending on flags. It stops at a minus 1 terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B82
name: emit_pattern_for_code_pairs
description: Writes five-row patterns for the codes plus and comma, or a default pattern for other codes, then continues scanning the code stream and advancing the output by flags.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B92
name: emit_pattern_code_pair_two
description: Writes a five-row pattern for the comma code or a default pattern for other codes, then scans the code stream and advances the output based on flags.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BA2
name: emit_pattern_for_default_code
description: Writes a five-row default pattern for each code, then scans the code stream and advances or splits the output by flags until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BC6
name: copy_previous_or_split_nibbles
description: Walks a code table, copying the previous record for codes 1 or 2 and halving low nibbles in several bytes for other flagged codes. It sets sentinel bytes in neighbouring records when the following code is flagged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BF2
name: split_nibbles_per_code_flags
description: Walks a code table, copying the previous record for codes 1 or 2 and splitting low nibbles between neighbouring bytes for other flagged codes. It writes sentinel bytes for runs when the next code is flagged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C02
name: split_nibbles_with_mask_parameters
description: Walks a code table using a mask and a count from the caller, splitting low nibbles between neighbouring bytes and copying the previous record for codes 1 or 2. Sentinel bytes are written when the following code is flagged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C32
name: split_nibbles_across_record_stream
description: Walks a code stream until the terminator, copying previous records for codes 1 or 2 and splitting nibble values for flagged codes. Sentinel bytes are written when the following code is flagged, and a loop handles longer runs.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2CEC
name: split_nibbles_until_end_code
description: Walks a code stream until the end code, copying the previous record for codes 1 or 2 and splitting nibbles for flagged codes. Sentinel bytes are written when the next code is flagged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D1C
name: remap_records_through_lookup_table
description: Walks eight-byte records from a fixed position, replacing the first three bytes of each record with values from a global lookup table. It skips records whose first byte is 254 and stops at the 255 terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D3E
name: copy_bytes_through_index_table
description: Copies bytes from a source buffer selected by an index table into a record stride, looping until an end code appears in the record stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D52
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns at once without reading or writing any memory. It is a stub with no logic.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D54
name: sum_records_into_checksum_byte
description: For each eight-byte record in a table, adds seven bytes read at the record stride, divides the total by eight, and stores the result at offset 24 of the record. It stops when a record starts with 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D70
name: accumulate_weighted_running_sum
description: Computes a weighted running sum over record bytes at the eight-byte stride, writing the averaged value into offset 24 of each record. The running total resets at the end of every six-byte group.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D86
name: compute_weighted_record_checksum
description: For each record, sums bytes at the eight-byte stride with a factor of two, subtracts a base byte and an extra byte, and stores a scaled result at offset 24. It stops when a record starts with 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DA4
name: compute_running_checksum_per_record
description: Accumulates a weighted running checksum across record bytes at the eight-byte stride, storing a scaled value at offset 24 of each record. The total resets after every six entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DCA
name: apply_code_offsets_to_records
description: Walks paired code and count streams and adds a per-code offset to a byte at offset seven of each eight-byte record. Codes with no change advance the output by their count, and one code writes minus 26 into every record it covers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DEC
name: apply_code_offsets_from_stream
description: Reads code and count pairs from a stream and adds offsets to a byte at offset seven of each eight-byte record. Codes with no change skip ahead by their count, and the stream ends at a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E38
name: add_code_stream_run_offsets
description: Writes a run of offsets for each code in a stream, adding 10 for the first code type and minus 26 for another. Codes with no change advance the output by their count and the routine ends at a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E48
name: add_negative_six_run_offsets
description: Adds a fixed offset of minus 6 to a run of records at offset seven, using the code stream to decide how far to advance. The loop ends at a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E4C
name: add_offset_runs_for_codes
description: Adds offset runs to records for each code in the stream, using a fixed offset of minus 6 for some codes and the code-specific offset for others. It stops at a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E50
name: add_offset_runs_then_skip
description: Adds offset runs to records for each code in the stream, skipping records with no change and returning at a 255 code. Codes with a flag bit set use a fixed offset of minus 6.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E54
name: fill_offset_runs_for_codes
description: Writes minus 26 into offset seven of each record in a run for one code, and adds a code-derived offset for others. It loops over the code stream until a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E68
name: apply_offset_runs_previous_byte
description: Adds offsets computed from the previous record's byte to a run of records, using the code stream to choose between runs and single steps. The routine ends at a 255 code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E80
name: decode_nibble_checksum_bytes
description: Computes a checksum from the low nibbles of groups of bytes, then from their high nibbles, and writes each result into the third byte of its group with the matching nibble masked. The two passes run over the same buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5230
name: init_signal_and_wait_loop
description: Allocates a signal bit through the Exec library, stores it in the structure with a computed signal mask, and loops calling a helper and waiting on the signal. It runs as a dispatch loop with no return.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:526E
name: fetch_messages_until_flag_set
description: Loops calling an Exec library function to fetch the next message, storing the message pointer when it is not of type 2 and calling a helper. A null result clears two flag bits in the request and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52A4
name: clear_request_flag_bits
description: Clears bits 1 and 0 of a flag byte at offset 34 of the request structure. It has no other effects and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52B4
name: setup_speech_io_request_send
description: Links buffer pointers for seven channels, fills fields of a speech I/O request block from the device data, derives a timing value by dividing a clock constant by a period word, and sends the request with the Exec DoIO call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5370
name: init_audio_channels_and_dma
description: Fills per-channel audio buffer pointers and clears channel state, computes a sample period from a clock constant, and enables audio DMA channels by writing the bits to the custom chip DMA control register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:548A
name: mix_wave_tables_into_samples
description: Generates audio samples by summing three lookup-table values per step and writes each sample to two output buffers. A phase accumulator advances per sample, and at the end of each block the routine calls helpers and updates envelope counters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5514
name: render_audio_block_with_pointers
description: Advances phase accumulators for the audio channels and writes samples for each channel into the output buffers. At the end of the block it writes the DMA control value to disable the channels and calls helpers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:558C
name: mix_wave_tables_with_envelope
description: Mixes three lookup-table values per sample with an envelope and writes the result to two output buffers. When a block ends it calls helpers and switches between two output buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5610
name: render_bouncing_sweep_samples
description: Generates audio samples while a sweep value moves by a step and reverses direction at two bounds, combining table lookups for each sample. When a block ends it calls helpers and continues with the next channel data.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56AE
name: sweep_samples_and_disable_dma
description: Generates audio samples while a sweep value bounces between two bounds, then reads channel data and writes the DMA control value to disable the channels when the stream ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56DC
name: render_samples_with_wave_entries
description: Renders audio samples by summing table lookups for each step, writing the sum to two output buffers and advancing a phase accumulator. Block ends call helpers and switch output buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56EA
name: wait_io_disable_audio_dma
description: Calls an Exec library WaitIO routine for each audio channel in a loop, and when a stop flag is set it writes the DMA control value that disables the channels before and after the loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:573E
name: enable_dma_if_flag_set
description: Tests a flag word in a structure and, when it is set, writes the DMA control value that enables the audio channels. It returns no value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5758
name: update_request_counter_and_relink
description: Increments a request counter and, when a stored byte has changed, moves a list node and updates a request field before calling a library routine. It writes 16384 to the interrupt-control value at the start and 49152 to re-enable interrupts when the counter drops to zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57CA
name: decrement_counter_and_enable_interrupts
description: Reads a counter byte from a structure, decrements it and writes it back. When the counter was zero or less it sets the global interrupt-control value to 49152, which enables interrupts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57DA
name: flag_channel_records_and_wait
description: Sets a flag bit on each channel record in a block and calls a helper for each one. Then it either sends an I/O request and waits for the channel's completion, or resets a field and calls a library routine, depending on a stop bit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57F6
name: flag_records_wait_for_io
description: Sets a flag bit on a block of channel records and calls a helper for each. It then waits on I/O completion through Exec library calls, enabling DMA if the stop bit is clear.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5838
name: wait_for_channel_io_loop
description: Enables DMA channels when a flag is set, then loops calling a helper and an Exec library routine until a completion byte becomes nonzero. The loop marks the request as done and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:587A
name: set_channel_done_flag
description: Sets bit 5 of a flag byte at offset 30 of the structure to mark the channel done, then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:S/MESSAGE:0:0000
name: call_library_entry
description: Calls a helper routine, then when the zero flag is clear calls a second helper and a function pointer taken from a global table. A final helper call precedes the return, and the message section uses it as its entry point.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:S/MESSAGE:0:0034
name: open_dos_library
description: Calls the Exec OldOpenLibrary routine with the dos.library name and stores the returned library handle in a global variable.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:KRAYZI:0:0000
name: unpack_bitstream_into_buffer
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source into a working buffer, then unpacks a bit-coded stream into bytes with shift-and-carry steps and helper calls. It also touches the background colour register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:KRAYZI:0:0070
name: load_bitstream_word_store_byte
description: Reads a 32-bit word from a fixed offset before the stream pointer, stores its low byte through a pointer, and returns the word shifted right by one with its top bit set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:KRAYZI:0:0096
name: consume_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right for a counted number of steps, reloading it through a helper whenever it becomes zero. It returns when the count is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:endcli:0:0136
name: copy_block_then_call_pointer
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in a structure into the buffer passed in, when one is given, then calls the routine stored at the pointer register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:0000
name: call_single_routine_at_entry
description: Program entry point that calls one other routine and references the text IMP!. The decompiled body is unavailable, so only its call structure and that text reference are described.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:001A
name: copy_block_and_fill_table
description: Copies 4648 bytes from the source pointer to a fixed destination, then fills a 4096-entry table with descending values and returns the value 65535. It also touches the background colour register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:0048
name: unpack_backward_bitstream_copy
description: Copies bytes backwards within a buffer under control of a bit stream, shifting bits from a source byte and copying runs whose lengths come from the stream. Six words of parameters are saved on the stack first.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:009A
name: decode_variable_length_bit_codes
description: Reads variable-length codes from a bit stream by repeatedly shifting the bit buffer and counting carries. It then looks up a base value in a global table and calls helpers to copy data.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:00D2
name: decode_bit_stream_length_pairs
description: Decodes length and offset pairs from a bit stream by shifting the bit buffer and counting carries, then combines a table value with the bit counts. It calls helpers to copy the decoded run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:00F6
name: decode_bitstream_table_lookup_run
description: Decodes a run from a bit stream by shifting the bit buffer, looking up values in a global table and repeating the shift count. Its result feeds the copy helpers it calls.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:00FC
name: decode_bitstream_literal_copy_loop
description: Decodes a bit-coded count from the stream by shifting bits from a source byte with carry steps, then copies bytes backwards for that many positions. Literal and copy-length choices come from a global table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:0102
name: decode_bitstream_short_runs
description: Decodes short runs from a bit stream using shift-and-carry steps and a global table lookup, then copies the decoded bytes backwards within the output buffer. It uses fewer table bits than its neighbours.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:0108
name: decode_bitstream_offset_runs
description: Decodes an offset and a run length from a bit stream, looking up base values in a global table, and copies the run backwards from the output position. Its control flow loops until the stream is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:012C
name: copy_bitstream_run_with_offsets
description: Decodes a run length and a table-based offset from a bit stream, then copies that many bytes backwards from the output pointer. Two tables supply the base offsets for the two copy paths.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:Intro:0:0168
name: copy_run_from_bitstream_offset
description: Decodes a bit-coded run and offset, copies the run backwards through the output buffer, and returns minus 1 when the output pointer has passed the buffer start, otherwise 0.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0000
name: create_library_node_or_fail
description: As library code, calls an Exec routine to allocate a node, and returns 0 when the allocation fails. Otherwise it stores two values in the node, calls a second library routine, and returns minus 1.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0040
name: increment_count_and_clear_flag
description: As library code, increments a short counter at offset 32 of the library node and clears bit 5 of the flag byte at offset 14.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0056
name: decrement_count_dispatch_if_flagged
description: As library code, decrements the short counter at offset 32 of the library node. When it reaches zero and bit 5 of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, it calls a dispatch routine and returns its result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0070
name: unlink_node_or_mark_pending
description: As library code, unlinks a node from its list when its counter at offset 8 is zero and calls a library routine. Otherwise it sets bit 5 of the flag byte at offset 14 to mark the node pending.
